estimate.method: Inverse iteration-count scaling of public one-block PBKDF2 benchmark; not an on-device measurement of this exact puzzle.

limitations: Not a security audit, best-attacker bound or guaranteed expenditure.
Uniform search may succeed early; mean and median near half the search space.
Parallel GPUs change elapsed time, not baseline total GPU-hours.
GPU kernel efficiency, price, ASICs, quantum computing and algorithmic breakthroughs may change cost.
Costs exclude tax, storage, orchestration, interruptions and engineering.
No GPU rental or attack budget was spent creating this capsule.
